license_summary.trapping_license: A Virginia trapping license is required to trap furbearers.
license_summary.reporting: All trapped bobcats and gray foxes must be reported within 24 hours through DWR's electronic harvest reporting system; CITES tags may be required for some bobcats and are required for raw otter pelts bought, sold, or transported out of state.
license_summary.locality_note: Certain localities and private lands have continuous open seasons for several furbearers — see the full DWR trapping regulations online.

Thompson WMAs), Loudoun, and Rappahannock counties; gray/red fox hunting closed in Albemarle, Clarke, Culpeper, Fauquier (except Quantico), Loudoun, Louisa, Rappahannock — county closures are noted in season notes but not modeled as separate zones.
